cover.alt: Class File Viewer on a jar: the package tree with Telescope selected, and its declarations in Java syntax with a Java 21 badge.
cover.tagline: Read compiled .class and .jar files. No JDK needed.

screenshots.headline: Bytecode with every constant explained
screenshots.alt: The Bytecode tab: a method's instructions like javap -c -v, constant pool references explained, line numbers and locals.

screenshots.headline: A whole jar at a glance
screenshots.alt: A jar's overview: 80 classes in 9 packages, a chart of Java versions, the module, Main-Class and multi-release versions.

screenshots.headline: Follow any constant to its users
screenshots.alt: The Constant pool tab: a selected Methodref, the entries it refers to, and the instructions and methods that use it.

screenshots.headline: Every byte of the class, mapped
screenshots.alt: The Structure tab: the class header, field and method tables, and each attribute with its offset and length, decoded or as hex.
